title: Bake-off (validators): deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
question: Who stands behind NEAR’s validators? Make me a fresh flower with their backers, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with the signature each completion got. A hash or link the model copied from a tool result is written as a reference to that result ($from, {{…}}), so it replays on recordedClient.

turns.content: I'll start by checking the network and what Petal already holds.
You asked for a fresh one, so I'll build it rather than offer the existing flowers.

interpretation.summary: This flower draws NEAR's validators and staking pools at block 222,915,356 (2026-11-03), sized by stake in the current epoch, and splits each pool's bar by who delegates to it: other delegators, accounts holding 1M+ NEAR, liquid-staking contracts and lockups. Power here means stake that can be used to produce blocks: 371 validators share 593,372,642.8 NEAR, the top 10 hold 36.2%, and 9 validators pass a third.

power_means.claim: Block production power in NEAR is staked NEAR assigned to a validator for the epoch; the top 10 validators hold 36.2% of it.
Behind the pools sit delegators: ordinary accounts, 1M+ NEAR accounts, liquid-staking contracts and lockups, which is what the bar segments split out.

mappings.why: square root of the validator's share of current-epoch stake, so mid-size pools stay visible next to the largest
the same share compressed into a band (log, max 2x) so bar widths encode stake without hiding small validators
each bar splits into backer classes: other delegators, 1M+ NEAR accounts, liquid-staking contracts, lockups; delegations under 1,000 NEAR are folded per class
kind of account, to tell staking pools from liquid-staking contracts and unknowns
solid for self-declared or verified identity, dashed for inferred, none when unknown — pool names are self-declared, not proven
largest stake first, clockwise from the top

conflicts: Stake is not the only power in NEAR: House of Stake veNEAR governance is a separate kind, not drawn here.
Liquid-staking contracts delegate pooled user funds; the token holders behind those contracts hold the real economic weight, which this flower shows only as one backer class.
unknowns: Liquid-staking token holders are not listed; their contracts appear as single delegators.
Delegators of the 424 idle pools (no seat, no proposal; ~6,656 delegation records) were not crawled and are missing.
Lockup owners are not resolved; lockups count as one backer class.
Delegations under 1,000 NEAR are folded into one group row per pool and class, so individual small delegators cannot be named.
Pool identities are self-declared via pool-details.near or a named account; none is verified.

turns.content:
**Flower**: [{{chatcmpl-tool-811f5f60f02dc98a.view_url}}]({{chatcmpl-tool-811f5f60f02dc98a.view_url}})

**What you'll see**: 60 petals for NEAR's validators and pools at block 222,915,356 (2026-11-03), largest first; each bar is divided into who delegates to that pool — other delegators, 1M+ NEAR accounts, liquid-staking contracts, lockups. Snapshot was reused (`reused: true`, the stored fixture at that block; the live delegator crawl is an offline script, so no fresh read is possible).

**Mapping**
- height — √ of the validator's share of current-epoch stake (`fastnear-rpc-validators`)
- width — same share, compressed into a 2× band (`fastnear-rpc-validators`)
- segments — backer class per pool (`fastnear-rpc-staking-pool-views`, `fastnear-rpc-liquid-staking`)
- colour — kind of account (`nearblocks-validators`, `fastnear-rpc-liquid-staking`)
- outline — solid = self-declared identity (`nearblocks-validators`, `account-id`)

Total 593,372,642.8 NEAR across 371 validators; top 10 hold 36.2%, 9 pass a third (`fig:top_k_share.10`, `fig:nakamoto`).

**Changed from the default**: segments → backers.

**What this can't tell you**: liquid-staking token holders aren't listed (their contracts count as one delegator); delegators of 424 idle pools weren't crawled; lockup owners unresolved; delegations under 1,000 NEAR folded per pool/class; pool names are self-declared; addresses are not people.
